cards.title: Your money is requested before tasks or withdrawals
dangerousRelationships: Applicant requested to pay to unlock work or earnings.
questions: Pause this payment. Why is your own money required before tasks or earnings? Ask an independent adviser to help you check using a reliable channel you found yourself.

cards.title: Personal borrowing or use of borrowed funds is requested
dangerousRelationships: Applicant requested to borrow in own name, transfer personal borrowing proceeds or pay using explicitly linked personal borrowing proceeds.
questions: Pause this borrowing, transfer or payment using personal borrowing proceeds. Why does the work require borrowing in your own name, or using existing borrowed funds? Check independently; a company repayment promise remains unverified.

cards.title: The text describes company payment or prohibits personal payment
benignControls: A prohibition is not a requested action.
questions: Which costs are paid directly by the company? Check through a company channel you found independently; a payment statement is not confirmation.

cards.title: Payroll details are not bank-account control
dangerousRelationships: Applicant requested to disclose a banking OTP or hand over account control: pause the requested disclosure and verify independently.
benignControls: Account details for payroll do not by themselves establish account control or a safe employer.
questions: Independently check who is requesting the information and why. Do not disclose banking passwords or one-time passwords (OTPs) to them, or hand over account control.

cards.title: Some details still need independent checking
benignControls: A changed duty without a financial demand is not a fraud finding.
questions: Who pays or borrows, and whose money is used? Is payment required for tasks or withdrawal? Clarify missing or conflicting details that affect personal financial exposure.

cards.title: You report that you have already acted
benignControls: User report is not official confirmation or recovered funds.
questions: What payment, borrowing or account action have you taken? Seek help through your bank app opened independently or the contact details on your card. Call 18222 for anti-scam advice; suspected victims should report at a police station.

cards.title: A work expense is not necessarily a task payment
benignControls: A transport or similar work expense is not by itself payment to unlock tasks or earnings.
questions: What is the expense for, and who pays it? Independently check the expense policy and reimbursement conditions; a reimbursement promise is neither confirmation nor permission to pay.
cards.contentType: source-inspired product synthesis; authored boundary control

routes.label: Anti-scam advice: 18222
routes.scope: 24-hour advice, not a crime report or employer certification. Suspected victims should report at a police station; call 999 for emergencies.

routes.label: Scameter official checking service
routes.scope: Open the official service yourself to check suspicious details. 'No record' does not mean risk-free and is not employer certification.

routes.label: Labour Department: job-trap guidance
routes.scope: General job-trap and checking advice; it does not authenticate a particular job or employer.

routes.label: Companies Registry: company-search information
routes.scope: Check registration information. A company's existence does not authorize this recruiter or payment instruction. Check official access conditions and fees.
